title: Position, distance, displacement
target: Distinguish a location, a total path length, and a change in position.
criteria: Label the origin, start, turn and finish.
Calculate path distance and signed displacement separately.
Explain why position and displacement can differ.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: On a number line with east positive, a rover starts at −3 m, turns at +5 m, and finishes at +1 m. Which label identifies its final position?
cpa.guide: Final position is the coordinate of the finish, relative to the chosen origin.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A route diagram marks a start S, a turn T, and finish F on a coordinate line. What must the origin label mean?
options: The start of every route necessarily.
cpa.guide: The chosen origin need not coincide with the start or finish.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A robot starts at 1 m, travels to 9 m, then returns to 4 m. What are total distance and displacement?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A walker goes 7 m west, then 2 m east. Taking east positive, what are distance and displacement?
cpa.guide: Path length is 9; signed net change is −7 + 2 = −5.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: An object starts at −6 m and finishes at +2 m. Why are final position and displacement different?
options: Final position is +2 m relative to the origin; displacement is +8 m relative to the start.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: The coordinate origin moves 10 m east while the physical route stays unchanged. Which quantity remains unchanged?
cpa.guide: Both endpoint coordinates shift equally, so their difference is invariant.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
